verdict.rationale: Unleash's docs describe 'impact metrics' tied to rollout thresholds (e.g., error rates, latency) sourced from application instrumentation, not customer-defined warehouse tables or ingested event data as a metrics source. There is no evidence of a warehouse connector, SQL-based metric definition, or event-ingestion pipeline for experiment metrics — missing for 10: warehouse/data-warehouse integration for metrics, custom SQL metric definition, event ingestion pipeline, and any docs showing PMs defining metrics from their own data.
